about_the_game:
The moment you click on him, you've stepped into the cage he meticulously wove.

Game Type:
Premium (Buy-to-Play) Visual Novel with Light Horror & Meta Elements, targeting a female audience.

Contains minor jump scares. Players with photosensitivity, please exercise caution.

Characters:

  • L: The perfect Student Council President, gentle only towards you.

  • Zuo Jian: Sunny and outgoing Band Vocalist & Guitarist. (Unromanceable?)

  • Lin Chuang: Cold, sharp-tongued Art Prodigy. (Unromanceable?)

WARNING: This work contains psychological horror. The story may cause discomfort.

About the Game:
We will add translations for additional regions based on the number of wishlists in those areas. Thank you for your interest!

The game was developed somewhat hastily; the full release will be more polished.

The synopsis and character introductions are basic; specifics need to be explored within the game.

Whether "unromanceable" characters can be pursued depends on the player... though someone might not be happy about it w.

The development team consists of only two people, both starting from scratch.
Therefore, please forgive any shortcomings. We will do our utmost to create the best game we envision.

Bug Reports & Feedback: 2701393516@qq.com

short_description: Psychological horror dating sim for women. Navigate a seemingly perfect school life where every sweet moment hides a lie. Why is the rooftop locked? Why is *they* so obsessed? Why only ‘L’? Your choices shape the truth—and every move is watched. Discover chilling endings.
